lines.say: Yah-mee Yah-mee no Mee. The Dark-Dark Fruit. A pirate killed his own crewmate to get it.
lines.show: Yami Yami no Mi. The Dark-Dark Fruit. A pirate killed his own crewmate to get it.

lines.say: It's a Lohjeeah fruit, but a strange one. Its darkness works like endless gravity. It pulls everything in.
lines.show: It's a Logia fruit, but a strange one. Its darkness works like endless gravity. It pulls everything in.

lines.say: Its user is Marshall Dee Teech. Better known as Blackbeard.
lines.show: Its user is Marshall D. Teach. Better known as Blackbeard.

lines.say: He sailed with the Whitebeard Pirates for years, waiting for this one fruit.
lines.show: He sailed with the Whitebeard Pirates for years, waiting for this one fruit.

lines.say: When his crewmate Thatch found it, Teech killed him, took the fruit, and ran.
lines.show: When his crewmate Thatch found it, Teach killed him, took the fruit, and ran.

lines.say: Black Hole. The darkness spreads across the ground and swallows whatever stands on it. Liberation spits it all back out.
lines.show: Black Hole. The darkness spreads across the ground and swallows whatever stands on it. Liberation spits it all back out.

lines.say: The scariest part? One touch, and another devil fruit user's powers are cancelled.
lines.show: The scariest part? One touch, and another devil fruit user's powers are cancelled.

lines.say: The price: his body can't turn intangible like other Lohjeeahs. He takes every hit, and feels even more pain.
lines.show: The price: his body can't turn intangible like other Logias. He takes every hit, and feels even more pain.

lines.say: On Bah-nah-roh Island, Ace's fire was swallowed by the darkness. Teech won, and handed Ace to the Marines.
lines.show: On Banaro Island, Ace's fire was swallowed by the darkness. Teach won, and handed Ace to the Marines.

lines.say: Then at Marineford, after Whitebeard fell, Teech stole the Tremor-Tremor Fruit too.
lines.show: Then at Marineford, after Whitebeard fell, Teach stole the Tremor-Tremor Fruit too.

lines.say: He's the only person known to wield two devil fruits. And nobody knows how.
lines.show: He's the only person known to wield two devil fruits. And nobody knows how.

lines.say: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
lines.show: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
